rationale: Three sensors (door_back, motion_living, win_bed) dropped within 2 seconds of each other (21:44:00–21:44:02) while the base station remained online with a healthy uplink and other devices (including the farther front camera) stayed online. The base station log shows E-610 radio module self-test warning, which the KB states must always be escalated to FAE when multiple peripherals drop simultaneously. This matches historical case H-05 (radio module replaced), and a base station restart already failed to recover the devices, confirming an L2 hardware-level radio fault rather than individual signal or battery issues.
